_comment: Agent Deck configuration. Copy to agentdeck.json next to server.js, or to ~/.config/agentdeck/agentdeck.json. Every key is optional and these are the defaults; command-line flags override the file. Keys starting with an underscore are comments and are ignored.
_comment_data: Where Claude Code keeps its files. null means the per-OS default: ~/.claude on macOS and Linux, %USERPROFILE%\.claude on Windows, the WSL home when detected; Docker uses /data/claude. sessions_include and sessions_exclude are path globs matched against each session's cwd; an empty include list means every session. stale_after_s is how long a session may go without a file change before it is labelled stale when process liveness cannot be checked (Docker, WSL from Windows). poll_ms is the registry and transcript polling interval.
_comment_server: Network. host 127.0.0.1 keeps the dashboard on this machine; 0.0.0.0 exposes it to the LAN (Docker sets this itself inside the container). open_browser opens the page on start; --no-open is the flag equivalent.
_comment_view: Default theme by file name under themes/ (spaceship or office ship with the app; add your own JSON there). The page can override it with #theme=<name> or the theme select.
_comment_context: Context alarms. context_warn_pct: percentage of the model's window at which the lead shows the '!' alarm and an attention row. context_compact_pct: percentage at which compaction is expected soon. context_limits maps an exact model id to its window in tokens; 'default' covers models not listed.
_comment_hooks: hooks_enabled accepts POSTs on /hook/<event> from the Claude Code hook snippet (node server.js --print-hooks). Off by default; nothing is installed into ~/.claude without --install-hooks. controls_enabled shows action buttons and enables /control; v1 is read-only so the route answers 'disabled' even when true.
_comment_logging: log_level: error, warn, info or debug. Logs go to stderr and to ~/.config/agentdeck/agentdeck.log (rotating, 5 MB). --verbose is the same as debug.
